EO-003.note: Native PNG Save/Save As validate paths and adopt only complete successful results. Full user-facing formats and filesystem/platform qualification remain. Native Save As now offers only PNG/JPEG/WebP with matching extensions, explicit required JPEG/WebP quality (0..100), and required opaque JPEG matte (#RRGGBB). PNG/WebP retain alpha; JPEG composites onto the chosen matte on the worker. Core validates options without clamping or invented persisted defaults. Actual codecs, bytes/hash, alpha/matte, quality changes, immutable source/annotations, pair reopen and companion-only repair are tested. Successful Save remembers chosen options only in that editor window; failed/partial Save As keeps the old durable path, and repair uses its acknowledged format without another encoding. Existing overwrite confirmation remains, all blocking save work now starts through OwnedWork, and an encoding-boundary cancellation regression prevents starting an encoder. Empty-document alpha messaging explicitly discloses that companions exist only with annotations, per ES-014. Full codec/profile/resource/native-target/fault/a11y/human qualification and reconciliation of the format-selection draft status remain Required. Audit 2026-11-03: Save writes the current durable path directly only when it passes validation, and a path that fails validation is never written: EditorWindowTest::saveUsesTheDurablePathOnlyAfterValidationAndSaveAsPickerIsAccessible (valid PNG path saves with no picker; an unsupported-extension durable path opens the picker instead and a cancel leaves file, companion and dirty title unchanged), with symlink/foreign-destination/oversize path refusal in EditorSaveTest::symlinksAndChangedCompanionsArePreservedAndParentSegmentsKeepKernelMeaning and encodeExceptionAndRacingReplacementPreserveThePreviousDestination. Save As uses the accessible native picker (EditorSaveDialogTest::saveAsPickerIsAnAccessibleSavePickerWithNamedControls and the window test assert the accessible name 'Save image destination and encoding', Save accept mode and named quality/matte controls) and never changes the current path before a complete write (EditorWindowTest::partialSaveAsKeepsTheCurrentPathUntilItsCompanionRepairCompletes, splitJpegSaveAsRepairsCompanionWithoutAdoptingPathEarly).

EO-010.note: Linux realization: editor File > Set as Wallpaper... (Ctrl+Alt+W) renders one owned source+visible-annotation snapshot as sRGB PNG with alpha through the existing preparation worker, shows a guarded confirmation (target: desktop background / lock screen / both; optional desktop preview; the exact retained file path), then writes the PNG atomically with owner-only (0600) permissions under <XDG data>/com.xerahs.app/linux-qt/wallpapers/ and passes it as a file descriptor to org.freedesktop.portal.Wallpaper SetWallpaperFile (options set-on, show-preview) using the same Request/Response handling as the Screenshot portal (unique-owner subscription before the call, early-response buffering, Close on abandonment). The portal has no per-display selection, so the dialog states that the desktop applies the image to all displays with its own layout; no per-monitor backend is invented. Typed results: succeeded (file retained and path shown in status/signal), cancelled (dialog cancel writes no file and makes no portal call; portal response 1; cancel while waiting closes the Request and keeps/discloses the file because the desktop may already have applied it) and failed with stable codes wallpaper-render-failed, wallpaper-annotation-unsupported, wallpaper-encode-failed, wallpaper-storage-failed, wallpaper-permission-denied, wallpaper-service-unavailable, wallpaper-failed, wallpaper-confirmation-failed. A file the portal definitively did not use (cancel/failure/denied) is removed. Document, history, dirty state and viewport are unchanged; editor destruction during render or during the portal request is safe. Tested on a private session bus with a fake Wallpaper portal. Remaining: product-owner decision whether the portal target choice (background/lock screen/both, all displays) satisfies the 'target display/layout choice' wording as an Equivalent disposition (per-display and fill/fit layout selection are not offered by the portal), real desktop-portal qualification (GNOME/KDE/Hyprland backends), file retention/cleanup policy for old wallpaper files, and accessibility qualification.

audit.coverage: Native Set as Wallpaper flow with confirmation, disclosed private retained file, portal transport and typed success/cancel/failure results is present and tested against a fake portal. Per-display and layout (fill/fit) selection are not available through the portal; real desktop-portal and accessibility qualification remain.

EO-013.note: Audit 2026-11-04: Clauses: Save/Discard/Cancel and failed/cancelled Save retain the editor; callback acknowledgement requires persisted artifacts and a clean checkpoint.
